name: Local hemp growing and hand-spinning clothing group

mentions.name: Local hemp growing and hand-spinning clothing group
mentions.description: This local community group grows hemp, then processes and spins the fiber by hand to collaboratively produce a sustainable, locally made item of clothing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tonight is a meeting of a local group growing hemp locally, processing and spinning by hand to make an item of clothing locally and sustainably between us all.
